pinnedSwiftPackage.declaredSPDX: Apache-2.0 WITH Swift Runtime Library Exception

method: Read-only compare of the pinned official package extraction, the frozen candidate dylib Mach-O architecture/build UUIDs, and the exact license text inside the candidate. No candidate bytes or signatures were modified.
scopeLimit: Matching architecture and Mach-O UUIDs bind the candidate binary to the same compiler build identity as the pinned Swift package payload; candidate and package-extracted dylib SHA-256 values differ because the candidate copy is signed. UUID equality is not byte-for-byte identity proof or legal advice. This evidence does not resolve notice obligations, reviewerDecision, overall licensing, candidate signature verification, runtime load, or release qualification.

officialLicenseReference.title: Swift License
officialLicenseReference.verifiedFinding: The official Swift license page states the Runtime Library Exception removes attribution requirements under Apache-2.0 sections 4(a), 4(b), and 4(d). The complete pinned license text remains included with the candidate.
